core_categories: Prescription Pharmaceuticals; Medical Materials; Medical Equipment; Clinical Diagnostic Reagents; OTC Medicines; Cosmetics and Daily Necessities; Animal Health Products; Food Processing Raw Materials
specialty_focus: Medipal Holdings is a major Japanese healthcare and daily-goods wholesale holding company, acting as a broadline distributor connecting manufacturers with hospitals, clinics, dispensing pharmacies, and retailers. It specializes in resilient logistics infrastructure, including earthquake-proof area logistics centers and cold chains, and uses a proprietary PFM® model to invest in drug development for distribution rights. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
